ExtraBar 1.2.8 – Your Bar, Your Way! 🎯✨

✨ What's New

  • Notch Mode: A brand-new display mode! Place your bar in the notch area for a sleek, integrated look – the perfect use of that screen real estate!
  • Primary Click Action: Assign any menu action to run when you click an app – one click, instant execution! Customize every app's click behavior to match your workflow!
  • App Aliases: Give any app a custom display name in the bar and menus – personalize your setup to make it truly yours!

⚡ Improvements

  • Silent Shortcuts: Run Shortcut actions no longer open the Shortcuts app UI when triggered – clean, seamless automation!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • App Icon Outlines: Fixed app icon outlines rendering incorrectly in some cases – crisp icons everywhere!
  • Bar Reappearance: Fixed the bar not reappearing after switching spaces or exiting fullscreen – your bar is always where you need it!

⚙️ Settings

  • Display Modes Revamped: Display Modes now shows three clear choices: Menu Bar, Notch, and Floating Bar – pick your perfect mode!

🎨 Customization

  • Duplicate Dividers: Dividers can now be duplicated in the menu editor – faster setup for your custom layouts!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
